title: SDR - , , Brazil
description:
VAGA: SDR (SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE) - FIXADORES INDUSTRIAIS E ACESSÓRIOS.


SOBRE A EMPRESA

Somos uma importadora e distribuidora referência no segmento de fixadores (parafusos, porcas, arruelas, chumbadores, barras roscadas). Estamos em plena expansão digital e já estruturamos nosso setor de Inside Sales com base na metodologia \"Receita Previsível\" . Agora buscamos nosso primeiro SDR para alimentar o pipeline com leads qualificados e acelerar nosso crescimento.


SOBRE A OPORTUNIDADE

Você será o primeiro SDR da empresa , trabalhando em parceria direta com nosso Inside Sales Specialist para implementar a máquina de vendas previsível. Esta é uma oportunidade única de construir processos do zero , ser a porta de entrada de todos os leads digitais e participar ativamente de uma estratégia que visa 10x o volume de oportunidades qualificadas .


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Qualificar leads gerados pelo marketing digital e prospecção ativa, identificando oportunidades reais (SQL - Sales Qualified Leads) e passando-as para o Inside Sales, seguindo rigorosamente a metodologia \"Receita Previsível\" .


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

QUALIFICAÇÃO DE LEADS INBOUND (50%)

  • Contatar 100% dos leads em até 30 minutos após captura.
  • Realizar qualificação inicial usando metodologia BANT (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline).
  • Identificar dor, urgência e fit com nosso portfólio.
  • Nutrir leads que não estão prontos para compra (lead nurturing).

PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA OUTBOUND (30%)

  • Executar cadências de prospecção em leads definidos pelo marketing
  • Realizar cold calls e cold emails estruturados
  • Pesquisar empresas e tomadores de decisão no LinkedIn/Google
  • Gerar SQLs através de prospecção ativa
  • Mapear empresas do setor de construção civil, indústria e manutenção

GESTÃO DE PIPELINE E PROCESSOS (15%)

  • Manter CRM 100% atualizado e organizado.
  • Documentar todas as interações com leads.
  • Seguir e otimizar playbooks de qualificação
  • Registrar objeções e padrões identificados
  • Participar de reuniões de forecast e planejamento

ALINHAMENTO COM MARKETING E INSIDE SALES (5%)

  • Fornecer feedback diário sobre qualidade dos leads por canal
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento (marketing + vendas)
  • Colaborar no aprimoramento de ICPs (Ideal Customer Profile) e personas
  • Sugerir melhorias nas campanhas baseadas no contato com prospects


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência : Em vendas B2B, telemarketing qualificado ou atendimento comercial
  • Comunicação : Excelente dicção, persuasão e escrita profissional
  • Resiliência : Capacidade de lidar com \"não\" e fazer follow-ups consistentes
  • Organização : Disciplina para seguir processos e atualizar CRM diariamente
  • Perfil Hunter : Proatividade para prospecção ativa e busca de novas oportunidades

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Conhecimento do livro \"Receita Previsível\" ou \"Fanatical Prospecting\" (Jeb Blount)
  • Experiência com cold calling estruturado
  • Vivência no setor industrial, construção civil ou distribuição B2B
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Social Selling (LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
  • Conhecimento em metodologias BANT, GPCT ou MEDDIC

COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Persistência : Não desiste após o primeiro \"não\", segue cadências completas
  • Curiosidade : Faz perguntas para entender a fundo a dor do prospect
  • Coachability : Aceita feedback e implementa rapidamente melhorias
  • Orientação por métricas : Acompanha seus números e busca superá-los
  • Trabalho em equipe : Colabora efetivamente com Inside Sales e Marketing


METAS E INDICADORES:

PROGRESSÃO DE VOLUME

  • Mês 1-2 : 70-100 leads/dia (período de treinamento e ajuste)
  • Mês 3-4 : 100 - 150 leads/dia
  • Mês 5+ : 150 - 200+ leads/dia

ATIVIDADES DIÁRIAS ESPERADAS

  • 100 - 200 tentativas de contato (calls, emails, WhatsApp)
  • 30 - 40 conversas efetivas com decisores
  • 8-12 SQLs gerados por dia (pós-rampa)


REMUNERAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS:

ESTRUTURA SALARIAL

  • Salário Base : R$ 2.800,00
  • Comissão por SQL Aceito : Valor específico por SQL aprovado pelo Inside Sales (Critérios definidos após contratação).
  • Bônus Trimestral : R$ 1.000,00 (atingimento de 100% da meta do setor comercial)

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Vale refeição : R$ 26,00 por dia útil

PLANO DE CARREIRA:

  • 6 meses : SDR Pleno (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 12 meses : SDR Sênior (liderança de novos SDRs) (transição baseada em performance) .
  • 18-24 meses : Promoção para Inside Sales Specialist (transição baseada em performance) .


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

  • Modalidade: Presencial;
  • Horário: Segunda a sexta, 8h às 17:48h;

title: Mecânica/o de Manutenção Jr
description:
Na Dori | Ferrara, Ferrero, Fox’s Burton’s Companies e The Fine Biscuits Company, somos reconhecidos e amados por pessoas de todas as gerações pela alegria que compartilhamos com elas – uma alegria feita pelas nossas pessoas. Junte-se a nós e descubra um mundo cheio de possibilidades, onde sua paixão encontrará o seu lugar.


A Dori | Ferrara é uma das maiores empresas de doces e snacks do Brasil! Há mais de seis décadas, com um time de mais de 3000 colaboradores, produzimos produtos que acompanham gerações e fazem parte da história e das lembranças de milhões de famílias, com marcas icônicas como Gomets®, Yogurte 100®, Pettiz® e Disqueti®.


Em 2023, iniciamos um novo capítulo ao nos tornarmos parte da Ferrara Candy Company, líder número 1 em balas e gomas nos Estados Unidos, com marcas mundialmente conhecidas como NERDS®, Brach’s®, Jelly Belly®, SweeTARTS®, Laffy Taffy®, and Trolli®. E, na França, a Carambar & Co conquistou gerações de clientes fiéis graças ao apelo atemporal de marcas icônicas de doces e chocolates, como Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Vichy e Terry’s.


Com essa união, somos mais de 9.000 colaboradores e uma rede com mais de 30 unidades, garantindo nossa presença global.


Mecânica/o de Manutenção Jr


O/a Mecânica/o de Manutenção Jr atuará no apoio às atividades de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos, auxiliando na identificação de falhas, realização de ajustes, reparos mecânicos e apoio nas rotinas da área, sempre seguindo normas de segurança e qualidade.


Localidade: Marília – SP


Reporta ao: Encarregado da Manutenção


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


Escala de trabalho: 12x36


Contamos com você para:


  • Auxiliar nas manutenções preventivas e corretivas de máquinas e equipamentos da unidade, incluindo moinhos de açúcar, motoredutores, detectores de metais e equipamentos dos setores de embrulhamento e empacotamento;
  • Apoiar na montagem, desmontagem e substituição de componentes mecânicos, como esteiras de túneis de resfriamento, gaxetas, retentores, anéis de vedação, entre outros;
  • Executar atividades de higienização, lubrificação e inspeção dos equipamentos, conforme programação e instruções de trabalho, incluindo verificação periódica da torre de resfriamento;
  • Atender Ordens de Serviço dentro dos prazos e padrões estabelecidos, realizando registros e apontamentos necessários, bem como apoiando outros mecânicos nas rotinas da área;
  • Manter a oficina de manutenção, ferramentas e locais de trabalho limpos, organizados e em condições adequadas de uso;
  • Cumprir e zelar pelas normas de Segurança do Trabalho, BPF, POPs, APPCC e demais legislações aplicáveis, utilizando corretamente os EPIs e participando de treinamentos e reuniões quando solicitado.


Do que você precisa para fazer a diferença:


  • Formação técnica concluída em Mecânica, Automação, Manutenção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos prático em mecânica industrial, automação, pneumática e/ou soldagem;
  • Experiência prévia em atendimento de linha e de processos contínuos;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho na escala de 12x36.


O que nós oferecemos:


Na Dori | Ferrara, nos orgulhamos de prover aos nossos colaboradores:


  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Refeitório ou vale refeição, de acordo com localidade;
  • Cesta de produtos ou vale alimentação, de acordo com localidade;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Dr Dori (telemedicina);
  • Clínica Aconchego;
  • Centro de Qualidade de Vida (atendimento com equipe multidisciplinar);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Totalpass;
  • Convênio com SESI Marília;
  • Desconto em produtos;
  • Horário flexível.


Igualdade de Oportunidades


Temos orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece igualdade de oportunidades e progressão de carreira. Para isso, as decisões e oportunidades de emprego na Dori | Ferrara serão baseadas no mérito, nas qualificações e nas habilidades, independentemente da raça, cor, credo, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade e expressão de gênero, estado civil ou união civil, nacionalidade, ascendência, cidadania, idade, condição de militar ou veterano, deficiência, informações genéticas, gravidez (parto ou condição médica relacionada) ou qualquer outra base proibida por lei.


A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).


Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Software Engineer C# Sênior
description:
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para conquistar o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Atuamos com soluções tecnológicas que simplificam e conectam pessoas, impactando positivamente a vida de milhares de usuários. Já contamos com mais de 100 mil veículos em circulação, presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México.


Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e a chance de transformar o futuro da mobilidade na região, aqui é o lugar certo para você.



Responsabilidades


  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta performance, com entusiasmo por ver seus resultados impactando milhares de clientes diariamente;
  • Colaborar ativamente com o time, com boa comunicação, disposição para aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Demonstrar perfil analítico e proativo, com foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, adaptando-se rapidamente a mudanças;
  • Ter senso de dono, com responsabilidade de ponta a ponta pelas aplicações;
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial para acelerar entregas e elevar a qualidade dos produtos;
  • Aplicar conceitos sólidos de orientação a objetos, design patterns e arquitetura escalável;
  • Atuar com práticas DevOps, incluindo manutenção e monitoramento de ambientes de produção.



Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 8 a 10 anos de experiência com C# e .NET Framework/Core;
  • Forte atuação no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Experiência com mensageria PUB/SUB (RabbitMQ, entre outros);
  • Uso de cache em aplicações (ex: Redis);
  • Criação e otimização de queries complexas;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como OpenAPI (Swagger), Postman, Git, GitFlow e Jira;
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (preferencialmente GCP);
  • Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (ex: Datadog, Dynatrace);
  • Conhecimento em microserviços (comunicação síncrona/assíncrona, Saga Pattern);

title: Sr Performance Management Specialist
description:
Join a market-leading financial services firm at a moment of transformation in how we measure, grow, and recognize performance. This role sits at the intersection of performance management, people analytics, and talent systems, partnering with senior HR and business leaders to elevate performance practices—making them more consistent, data-driven, and genuinely developmental.


You’ll be the person who can translate complex data into clear insights, run high-stakes talent forums, and design performance rhythms that leaders trust. If you enjoy combining analytics + executive storytelling + operational rigor, this is for you.


What you’ll do

  • Own and evolve the performance management cycle end-to-end (goal setting, mid-year, year-end, promotions linkage where applicable).
  • Lead and facilitate performance conversations with leaders: coaching, challenging, and ensuring fairness and clarity.
  • Drive 9-box talent reviews, calibration sessions, and governance forums—ensuring decisions are evidence-based and aligned to policy and culture.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards and analytics (trends, distribution shifts, rater bias signals, differentiation, attrition risk correlations, time-to-readiness, etc.).
  • Create crisp, executive-ready materials: PowerPoint narratives and Excel models that senior stakeholders can act on immediately.
  • Partner closely with HRBPs, Total Rewards, Talent Management, and business leadership to align performance outcomes with development actions.
  • Support (and often lead) enhancements to talent management systems and performance workflows; identify opportunities for automation and stronger data integrity.


What we’re looking for (must-haves)

  • 3+ years of experience in performance management, people/talent analytics, or closely related HR COE work (ideally in complex, fast-paced environments).
  • Demonstrated hands-on leadership of:
  • Performance conversations (manager enablement, coaching, communication)
  • 9-box facilitation and outcomes
  • Calibration design and execution
  • Expert-level PowerPoint and Excel skills: you can build a leadership narrative, not just slides; you can model and audit data confidently (pivots, advanced formulas, scenario views; PowerQuery is a plus).
  • Strong experience with talent management / performance management software (enterprise tools).
  • Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken). Spanish is a plus.


Nice to have


  • Experience with performance management tools (Oracle, Success Factors, other)
  • Familiarity with change management and rollouts across large populations.


How success looks in this role


  • Leaders describe the process as clear, fair, and decision-ready—not a compliance exercise.
  • Calibration outcomes show reduced noise, improved differentiation quality, and stronger documentation.
  • Performance insights shift from “reporting what happened” to predicting and influencing outcomes.
  • Executive stakeholders rely on your materials because they are simple, sharp, and data-grounded

title: Full Stack Developer (Python) - Founding Engineer
description:
About Sofira:

Sofira is building the future of legal services. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work, leveraging our team's 12 years of experience processing millions of legal documents.


The Opportunity: Become a Founding Engineer

This isn't just another Senior Developer role. This is a chance to be a core member of our founding engineering team, reporting directly to our CTO, Pedro Leme (ex-Head of Engineering at Jusbrasil).

You will be solving some of the most complex and interesting technical challenges in the Brazilian tech scene today. Your mission will be to build a robust, scalable platform that tames the chaos of legacy government systems and leverages the latest in Generative AI to deliver real-world value. If you are driven by solving hard problems that have a massive impact and want to build the technical foundations of a future market leader, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do (Your Mission):

  • Design and build the foundational architecture for our AI agent platform, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and secure from day one to support our journey towards ISO 27001 certification.
  • Lead the complex engineering challenge of integrating with dozens of legacy government systems, transforming our core competitive advantage into a robust and reliable service.
  • Develop the data and machine learning infrastructure that powers our agents—including our proprietary data processing pipelines and vector databases—in close collaboration with our ML Engineer.
  • Take full ownership of key features across the entire stack, from our Python backend and APIs to our modern frontend, ensuring a seamless and high-quality user experience.
  • Champion engineering excellence through high-quality code, robust testing, and collaborative code reviews, helping to define the technical culture of Sofira as a founding engineer.


Who You Are (The Profile):

We value your mindset and your ability to execute above all else. You are the right fit if:

  • You have a deep sense of ownership.  You don't just write code; you take ownership of features from the initial idea through to deployment and maintenance. You feel the pain when things break and the pride when customers are delighted.
  • You are a pragmatic builder with a natural 'hacker mindset'.  You don't freeze when faced with the unknown; you find the simplest, most efficient path through complex problems. You have a strong bias for action and favor clever, practical solutions that work now over theoretically perfect ones that might work someday.
  • You are relentlessly proactive and a self-starter.  You don't wait for tasks. You see opportunities for improvement in the codebase, in the infrastructure, or in a process, and you take the initiative to fix them.
  • You are a true Full Stack professional.  You are comfortable and skilled in both backend and frontend development and are not afraid to learn new technologies to get the job done.
  • You are a strong collaborator.  You enjoy working in a tight-knit team, engaging in healthy debates about technical decisions, and mentoring other engineers as the team grows. You know how to leverage your peers to find the best solutions.
  • You are mission-driven and ambitious.  You are excited by the opportunity to build a category-defining company from the ground up. You are energized by the mission, not just the clock.


What You'll Need (The Hard Skills):

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Deep expertise in Python  and at least one of its web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django, Flask).
  • Solid experience with a modern frontend framework (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte).
  • Strong knowledge of SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications on a major cloud provider (GCP, AWS, or Azure).
  • Fluency in English.
  • Huge Plus (Bonus Points):
  • Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.).
  • Familiarity with the RAG pattern, LangChain, or vector databases.
  • Familiarity with AI Agents patterns and libs.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS startup.


Why You'll Love Building Sofira With Us:

  • Solve Hard, Interesting Problems:  You will work on a unique technical challenge – taming Brazil's legacy systems with modern AI. This is not another CRUD app.
  • Build with the Best Tools:  We have an AI-first engineering culture. You will be equipped with tools like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to maximize your productivity and focus on creative problem-solving.
  • Build from Zero & Have a Massive Impact:  As a founding engineer, your decisions will shape our product, our culture, and our future success.
  • Ownership:  We want our founding team to have a real stake in our success.

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan® , the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan® is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan® available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health . As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH ), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.


Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.


To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:


CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)


The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.


This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.



Main activities:


  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise


Experience / Education / Special Requirements



You have a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.


You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.


Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.


You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.



Please submit your application and CV in English.



Why join ECHOSENS ?


  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.




ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Analista de Suporte Pleno - Cloud/DevOps
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Suporte Pleno - Cloud/DevOps



Empresa

Medimos o que as pessoas realmente consomem na mídia, para oferecer a anunciantes, agências, emissoras e proprietários de conteúdo uma compreensão real do valor de cada meio e ajudá-los a otimizar suas estratégias de mídia.



Atividades

  • Dar suporte aos clientes (suporte nível 2 / suporte especializado) no escopo de sistemas de medição de audiência (tecnologias de audio matching / watermarking).
  • Analisar e reproduzir problemas dos clientes, investigar (troubleshooting) e resolvê-los por meio de soluções técnicas ou alternativas (workarounds).
  • Acompanhar problemas por meio de ferramentas de chamados (ticketing), mantendo diálogo contínuo com os clientes.
  • Auxiliar os clientes na instalação e manutenção de seus sistemas.
  • Instalar e testar novas versões de produtos e garantir que sejam devidamente testadas antes de sua liberação aos clientes.
  • Elaborar processos e documentos informativos (FAQ, guias “como fazer”, notas técnicas) relacionados à configuração, implantação e suporte de sistemas de medição de audiência, a fim de ajudar os clientes na instalação e manutenção.
  • Apoiar atividades de pré-venda com aconselhamento técnico quando necessário.
  • As atividades de suporte exigirão viagens internacionais ocasionalmente.



Requisitos

  • Experiência técnica em arquiteturas distribuídas em rede (serviços em nuvem, Docker, VirtualBox, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, IBM Cloud, Azure etc.), baseadas em sistemas Linux, idealmente para aplicações multimídia (vídeo/áudio).
  • Preferencialmente, experiência inicial como engenheiro de suporte, engenheiro de testes ou engenheiro de campo em integradores de sistemas ou fabricantes.
  • Experiência em administração de sistemas Linux (Debian, RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu).
  • Conhecimento básico de protocolos de rede (roteamento, tunelamento etc.) e experiência em depuração de problemas de rede.
  • Ferramentas DevOps (Kibana, Grafana, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano em cursos de tecnologia.
  • Inglês fluente.



Diferenciais

  • Experiência com tecnologias de áudio e análise básica de áudio (ferramentas como Audacity).
  • Conhecimento de interfaces de áudio (placas de som, interfaces de áudio) e sintonizadores profissionais de TV.
  • Experiência com scripts em Python em ambiente Linux.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento de sistemas como Zabbix.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

Elaborar relatórios de progresso e apontamentos técnicos.

title: Gerente de conteúdo digital e audiência
description:
SOBRE A VAGA

O canal Amado Mundo busca um(a) gerente de conteúdo digital e audiência para liderar sua equipe de social media, além de implementar estratégias de crescimento e distribuição de conteúdo em múltiplas plataformas. Essa pessoa será responsável por conectar conteúdo, dados e performance, garantindo que nossas histórias alcancem, engajem e expandam a audiência de forma consistente.

O(a) profissional liderará uma equipe de analistas de social media e atuará de forma transversal com os times de Audiovisual, Site, Comercial e Eventos. É essencial que o(a) profissional tenha foco em crescimento orgânico e pago, otimização contínua e tomada de decisão orientada por dados.


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Gerenciar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas de social media
  • Supervisionar a produção de conteúdo para as redes sociais a partir dos videocasts do canal no YouTube, do conteúdo do site e dos eventos promovidos pelo Amado Mundo
  • Liderar a estratégia de crescimento de audiência em YouTube, Instagram, TikTok e site
  • Definir e acompanhar metas de performance (alcance, retenção, CTR, tempo de consumo, conversão)
  • Garantir a implementação de estratégias de SEO para conteúdo editorial e site
  • Liderar campanhas de mídia paga (ads) para aquisição de audiência
  • Garantir consistência e adequação da linguagem de conteúdo para cada plataforma
  • Estruturar testes (A/B) de formatos, títulos e abordagens
  • Implementar processo de otimização de títulos, thumbnails, ganchos narrativos e formatos de conteúdo
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento orgânico com base em dados e tendências de plataforma
  • Analisar métricas de performance e traduzir dados em insights acionáveis e recomendações estratégicas
  • Monitorar tendências digitais, comportamento de audiência e mudanças de algoritmo
  • Otimizar a experiência do usuário no site, com foco em navegação, tempo de permanência e consumo de conteúdo


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada em crescimento de audiência digital
  • Experiência com gestão de times de social media ou performance
  • Domínio de plataformas sociais (especialmente YouTube, Instagram e TikTok)
  • Conhecimento sólido em SEO (on-page e conteúdo)
  • Conhecimento sólido em mídia paga (Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads)
  • Forte capacidade analítica e orientação a dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de analytics (ex: Google Analytics e ferramentas nativas de plataformas)
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de conteúdo digital (títulos, hooks, retenção, storytelling)
  • Experiência com testes e otimização contínua (A/B testing)
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times multidisciplinares


DIFERENCIAIS

Experiência em veículos de mídia, conteúdo editorial ou canais no YouTube

  • Conhecimento em estratégia de conteúdo multiplataforma
  • Experiência com funil de aquisição e retenção de audiência
  • Familiaridade com UX e comportamento do usuário em ambientes digitais
  • Interesse por política, cultura, comportamento e temas contemporâneos


PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Orientação forte a resultados e crescimento

  • Mentalidade analítica com capacidade de transformar dados em ação
  • Olhar estratégico combinado com execução prática
  • Curiosidade constante sobre comportamento de audiência e tendências digitais
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipe
  • Autonomia 


LOCALIZAÇÃO

100% remoto.


REMUNERAÇÃO

R$ 12 mil, contratação PJ.


Interessados(as), enviar currículo e portfólio para: .


SOBRE O AMADO MUNDO

O Amado Mundo é uma startup digital de comunicação com atuação no YouTube ( site ( e redes sociais. Nossa missão é criar conversas que traduzem a complexidade do mundo contemporâneo em contexto, repertório e reflexões para a vida adulta.

Lançado em junho de 2025 pelo jornalista Guilherme Amado, o canal no YouTube oferece uma variedade de videocasts que aliam jornalismo e entretenimento. O site complementa essa cobertura com um time de repórteres e colunistas que trazem informações exclusivas e contextualizadas, para ajudar o leitor a navegar pelos principais assuntos do Brasil e do mundo.

title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst
description:
We are supporting a global company in the search for a highly qualified Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst in São Paulo, Brazil.


POSITION SUMMARY


The Senior HR & Office Administration Analyst will support the Country Director in leading the Human Resources and Administrative routines of the business, ensuring operational excellence, compliance and efficient employee experience. This position plays a key role in maintaining HR processes, payroll interface, office administration, vendor management and employee engagement initiatives, contributing directly to the smooth running of the organization. Advanced to fluent English is mandatory, as this role requires daily interaction with the international headquarters and corporate stakeholders.

  • Prepare and submit employee data to Group HR for demographic analysis and management reporting.
  • Support employee insurance administration, including enrollments, submissions, and claims follow-up, ensuring timely and accurate processing.
  • Oversee the payroll process managed by the outsourced payroll provider, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with statutory obligations.

  • Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, internal meetings, and company events.
  • Provide administrative support to the leadership team, including scheduling, correspondence, travel arrangements, hotel bookings, transportation, and other logistics.
  • Organize accommodation, transportation, courier services, and office support services required for daily business operations.
  • Maintain organized office files, records, and administrative documentation, ensuring accessibility and accuracy.


REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration or related fields is preferred.

Solid knowledge of Brazilian Labor Law (CLT) and HR best practices.

Microsoft Office and HRIS

Advanced to fluent English is mandatory

description:
Venha fazer parte do time da maior rede de joalherias da América Latina! Com mais de 60 anos de história, desenvolvemos um portfólio de marcas – Vivara, Life by Vivara, Vivara Watches, Vivara Fragrances e Vivara Accessories, com foco em joias de ouro, joias de prata, relógios e acessórios.

Aqui você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, diverso, repleto de desafios e com muitas oportunidades de crescimento. Se você se considera uma pessoa criativa, resiliente, gosta de atuar como dona do negócio e é movida por resultados, já tem meio caminho andado.


Na Vivara, acreditamos na inclusão e na diversidade, e as apoiamos em todas as suas formas de expressão para construir um lugar em que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas. Recriminamos qualquer tipo de discriminação, seja por idade, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, cor, etnia, deficiência ou religião.


Vem brilhar com a gente! #VemPraVivara


Estamos no modelo presencial.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Ser responsável pela gestão do time de CRM na frente de dados, análises de cliente e plataforma de campanha;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir indicadores de cliente (RFV, churn, CAC e LTV), apoiando decisões estratégicas de CRM e fidelização;
  • Construir e manter dashboards estratégicos de cliente, garantindo visão clara, confiável e acionável para o negócio;
  • Gerar insights de comportamento do cliente para otimização de réguas de relacionamento, jornadas e estratégias de comunicação;
  • Conduzir estudos e análises aprofundas de cliente, atendendo demandas de CRM, E-commerce, Marketing, Comercial, Produto e Expansão;
  • Analisar a performance dos canais e ativações de CRM (e-mail, push, SMS, WhatsApp, agenda e cashback), acompanhando KPIs de engajamento, conversão e valor do cliente;
  • Atuar como ponto focal dos dados de cliente na Vivara, assegurando alinhamento entre dados, estratégia e execução;
  • Garantir a qualidade, governança e uso estratégico dos dados de CRM;
  • Participar da construção da CDP com o objetivo de transformar os dados de compra, produto inteligência de cliente;

  • Capacidade de traduzir grade volume de dados em insights acionáveis, apoiando decisões de negócio e estratégias de CRM;

title: Payroll Analyst
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

This team is responsible for the ongoing coordination of payroll processing activities, including the collection and validation of payroll inputs, and the validation and controls of monthly payroll run outputs, with the overarching objective of processing salaries in a timely and accurate manner across the region. The team liaises continuously with multiple internal stakeholders (employees, HR and Finance colleagues) and the outsourced payroll services provider, providing expert advice on payroll-related topics.


Job Description

The Payroll Analyst is responsible for the complete, end-to-end management and execution of the payroll cycle for the Brazilian entity, ensuring flawless accuracy, strict legal compliance, and maximum process efficiency.

This professional will serve as the primary payroll and Personnel Administration (DP) subject matter expert (SME), closely collaborating with the Finance, Human Resources, and Occupational Health and Safety teams to ensure the accurate interpretation and application of all national labor laws and their financial implications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Payroll Operations: Manage and execute the full payroll lifecycle, including data entry, processing, advances, monthly closing, and managing all related bank transactions.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Reporting (DP Focus): Ensure absolute compliance with all local taxes, statutory obligations, and labor legislation (CLT). This includes managing specific government requirements such as eSocial, eConsignado, and other mandated regulatory reporting.
  • Financial Reconciliation: Lead the complex payroll general ledger account reconciliation process and coordinate the period closing activities with the Accounting and Finance teams.
  • Absence & Leave Management: Oversee and accurately process all employee events related to Personnel Administration (DP), including absences, sick leaves, medical leaves, and temporary contract suspensions and legally mandated leaves, ensuring adherence to company policy and legal requirements.
  • Policy & Audit Support: Review, develop, and update internal payroll and DP policies and procedures. Act as the key contact and support resource for both internal and external audits.
  • System Administration: Configure and maintain the payroll system (e.g., ADP) to reflect new rules, regulations, and benefit changes. Manage all payments to payroll-related third-party vendors.
  • Strategic Reporting: Develop and deliver insightful managerial reports and in-depth analyses of payroll processes to support business decision-making and forecasting.


Basic Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Accounting, or Human Resources Management, with a strong focus or specialization in Personnel Administration (Departamento Pessoal - DP).
  • Experience: Proven, extensive experience in end-to-end payroll processing and administration in a complex environment.
  • Legal Expertise: Deep knowledge and understanding of local Brazilian Labor Legislation (CLT) and associated union/collective bargaining obligations.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in payroll systems (e.g., ADP is highly preferred), Advanced Excel skills, and experience with Google Workspace/Tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to perform complex account reconciliation, proactively identify issues, and resolve discrepancies quickly and accurately.
  • Analytical Ability: Strong capacity to gather data, perform complex analysis, and develop clear, actionable managerial reports.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for effective interaction with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and auditors.
  • Language: Advanced English proficiency is required. Spanish proficiency is desirable.


EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Buscamos alguém com boa experiência em Java, confortável em atuar com microsserviços e desafios técnicos do dia a dia. Valorizamos um perfil autônomo, que gosta de resolver problemas com iniciativa e responsabilidade.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
The Company

Push is an all-in-one platform that helps businesses grow and scale their companies by simplifying HR, payroll, time tracking, and scheduling. Our purpose is to help our customers free up their time by making people management ridiculously easy, so they can focus on their passion.


Our customer base includes some of the biggest brands, such as Earls Restaurant, Cactus Club, Crumbl Cookies and more.


The Team

We’re a collaborative, dog-loving, people-first crew that values curiosity, initiative, and kindness. Our culture is built on the belief that when people are supported to grow, great things happen for them and for our customers. As part of our growing team, you'll play a key role in helping our customers realize the full value of Push from day one.


Take a look at a day in the life of our team: Behind the Scenes with our Software Engineers


The Role

We're looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our growing Engineering team! If you have a sharp eye for detail and a passion for ensuring quality through hands-on manual and automated testing, this role could be a perfect fit. You will play a key role in embedding quality into every stage of the development lifecycle.


You’ll influence automation initiatives, refine QA processes, and mentor others on best practices. Your primary responsibility will be identifying bugs, verifying fixes, and ensuring a high-quality product experience for our customers.


This role collaborates closely with our Vancouver team. The successful candidate will work 10:00am - 6:00pm local Brazil time to ensure sufficient time zone overlap.


Job Duties:

  • Champion quality assurance and lead the adoption of best practices across the product and engineering teams
  • Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and product managers to define effective test strategies and acceptance criteria
  • Plan, design, and execute detailed manual and automated test cases to ensure full coverage of features and user scenarios
  • Drive technical decisions for our software testing processes and tools
  • Build, maintain, and help drive the direction of the test automation framework
  • Mentor test engineers on automation best practices
  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear and actionable reporting
  • Verify fixes, maintain comprehensive regression test suites, and drive continuous improvement of QA processes
  • Conduct exploratory, usability, and edge-case testing to uncover hidden issues
  • Produce detailed test reports and effectively communicate findings and risks to stakeholders
  • Help define, maintain, and improve test environments to mirror production conditions
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance QA workflows, tooling (including modern AI tools), and team efficiency


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or QA, with proven expertise in manual and automated testing and strong analytical skills
  • Experience designing and implementing QA strategies in agile development environments
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Cypress , Selenium , or similar frameworks
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or a related field
  • Demonstrated success in elevating QA standards and improving product quality across releases
  • Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and testing lifecycles
  • Proficiency in exploratory, regression, and smoke testing techniques
  • Experience with cross-browser, cross-platform, and responsive UI testing
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Familiarity with Jira or other project management and defect tracking tools
  • Familiarity with source control management tools such as Git
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating tests into automated build processes
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or another high-level programming language
  • Leadership experience in software development or software testing
  • Proficiency with modern AI-driven tools such as Claude Code


Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with performance, security, or accessibility testing
  • Experience in startup or fast-paced environments
  • Knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms
  • Experience testing mobile applications
  • Experience leading a team of software testers


Why Push?

  • Do what you love. We believe in work that energizes you and supports your passions.
  • Grow yourself. At Push, personal and professional development go hand in hand.
  • Make an impact. Your knowledge and guidance will shape the success stories of businesses across North America.


Check out our About Us video


Additional Information

We value non-traditional career paths. If your experience doesn’t check every box but you’re excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply.


Push is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity makes us stronger and more innovative.


--

To help our hiring team with the review process, please ensure your resume is submitted in English.

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Composição visual, Cor, luz e forma, Tipografia e Princípios básicos de animação

title: Analista de Projetos Agile - Projetos de Software
description:
Você curte organizar, tirar impedimentos do caminho e transformar status confusos em relatórios claros e bonitos? Aqui você vai orquestrar entregas com nossos clientes, garantir visibilidade do progresso e manter tudo rodando redondinho no Jira.


Propósito da Vaga:


Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos projetos dos clientes Timeware — do planejamento à entrega — garantindo controle de atividades, evolução por frentes, comunicação executiva (status report/newsletter) e relacionamento contínuo no pós-venda (perfil farmer ), atuando como ponte entre stakeholders e times técnicos.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Conduzir a rotina de delivery : planejar sprints, acompanhar execução, remover impedimentos e gerir dependências.
  • Manter o Jira vivo : boards, epics, stories, burndown, dashboards e relatórios padronizados por cliente.
  • Status Report executivo quinzenal/mensal: progresso por frente, riscos, plano de ação, próximos passos e decisões pendentes.
  • Newsletter de projetos para stakeholders: highlights, marcos, releases e métricas de saúde.
  • Gerenciamento de roadmap e releases (em parceria com Produto/Tech Leads).
  • Reuniões e visitas a clientes (pós-venda farmer): alinhamento, satisfação, identificação de upsell/cross-sell e oportunidades.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retro, refinement) e adotar boas práticas de fluxo (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Acompanhar OKRs / KPIs de delivery (lead time, throughput, previsibilidade, SLA, NPS).
  • Produzir apresentações executivas (PowerPoint) e planos de projeto (escopo, cronograma, riscos, comunicação).
  • Garantir rastreabilidade : decisões, atas, RAID log e versionamento dos artefatos.
  • Trabalhar com áreas técnicas (Engenharia, QA, SRE, Dados) para definir abordagens, estimativas e critérios de aceite.


Atividades do dia a dia:


  • Atualizar boards, prioridades e dependências no Jira.
  • Preparar dashboards e relatórios (Jira/Excel/PowerPoint).
  • Rodar dailies/semanais com o time e checkpoint executivo com o cliente.
  • Monitorar riscos e acionar plano de mitigação .
  • Consolidar release notes e comunicar entregas.
  • Visitar clientes (agenda combinada) para health-check e alinhamento de expectativas.


Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills):


  • Métodos : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Lean Inception , Design Thinking, PMBOK/PMI, ITIL (gestão de mudanças e incidentes).
  • Ferramentas : Jira (obrigatório), Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint (avançado), Excel (tabelas dinâmicas / gráficos),
  • Visio/Miro/Draw.io; noções de Power BI são bem-vindas.
  • Gestão por métricas : lead/cycle time, CFD, burndown/burnup, throughput, previsibilidade, capacidade.
  • Documentação : RAID log, matriz RACI, cronogramas, atas e planos de comunicação.
  • Inglês : leitura técnica; conversa é diferencial.


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):


  • Organização e senso de dono (accountability).
  • Comunicação executiva (escrita e fala objetivas, visuais claros).
  • Negociação e alinhamento de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Priorizar sob pressão mantendo qualidade e previsibilidade.
  • Visão cliente (farmer) : relacionamento, percepção de valor e expansão.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificações: PSM/CSM, KMP, PMI-ACP, ITIL , OKRs/Lean Inception.
  • Vivência com produtos digitais, SaaS, SRE/DevOps, dados/BI .
  • Experiência montando comitês executivos e governança de portfolios .
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados (compliance, auditoria, segurança).

title: Clinical Application Specialist
description:
A pioneer in its field, Echosens significantly changed the practice of liver diagnosis with FibroScan® , the non-invasive gold standard solution for comprehensive management of liver health.

FibroScan® is recognized worldwide as the reference for liver fibrosis and liver steatosis assessment with more than 5 380+ peer-reviewed publications and 210+ international guidelines.

Echosens has made FibroScan® available in over 127 countries through its network of subsidiaries in Europe (Germany, Spain, UK, Italy), the United States and China (Shanghai, Shenzen and Hong Kong), enabling millions of liver examinations worldwide.

Echosens is shaping the future of liver health . As a high-tech company, its connected solutions and services empower medical professionals to manage liver health for simpler, faster and better patient care.

In today's digital healthcare environment and the silent epidemic of fatty liver disease (MASLD-MASH ), Echosens is pursuing its international expansion and aims to make the liver check-up part of the health routine for at-risk patients, particularly people living with diabetes.


Joining Echosens means choosing a rich and rewarding career path within an inclusive and dynamic company in a rapidly changing sector: liver health.


To support its strong growth, Echosens is recruiting a:


CLINICAL APPLICATION SPECIALIST (M/W)

LATAM (ideally Mexico or Brazil)


The overall objective is to drive the successful adoption of Echosens technologies across Latin America by supporting healthcare professionals through clinical training, implementation, and ongoing education.


This role plays a key part in empowering medical teams to integrate innovative liver health solutions into their clinical practices and deliver better outcomes for patients.



Main activities:


  • Support the implementation and clinical adoption of Echosens FibroScan technology in healthcare institutions across LATAM
  • Deliver clinical training and education to healthcare professionals and distributor teams
  • Provide clinical and technical support to ensure optimal use of technology
  • Support the sales team with product demonstration, key account training, and clinical expertise


Experience / Education / Special Requirements



You have a bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field, and equivalent clinical or technical experience will also be considered. You bring proven experience in implementing and supporting clinical applications within healthcare environments, with a strong understanding of healthcare workflows, processes, and systems.


You have excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to deliver effective training and provide user support. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards, as well as ultrasound expertise, would be an additional asset.


Fluent in Spanish, Portuguese and English, you are comfortable communicating across diverse teams and healthcare settings. You thrive in collaborative, cross-functional environments and are experienced in coordinating training programs, clinical implementation processes, and other operational methodologies.


You are results-driven, proactive, and self-sufficient, able to identify opportunities, gain consensus, and execute solutions efficiently. Your integrity, trustworthiness, and commitment to diversity of thought, combined with strong relationship-building and communication skills, enable you to excel in international healthcare environments.



Please submit your application and CV in English.



Why join ECHOSENS ?


  • Work on high-impact projects, serving the health of patients around the world.
  • Join a growing, innovative company, where your ideas will be valued and where you can make a difference.
  • Benefit from a collaborative and stimulating work environment, with opportunities for professional development.
  • Contribute to cutting-edge products, within a team passionate about innovation.
  • Adhere to our inclusion, equality and diversity program set up to support our employees in their efforts to be recognized as workers with disabilities.




ECHOSENS is an equal opportunity company in an environment of diversity and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, training, promotion or other employment practices because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, health or disability, or any other status protected by law.

title: Analista de Experiência do Cliente e Pós-Vendas
description:
Se você é movido por resultados, gosta de estar na linha de frente com o cliente e sabe que um bom relacionamento e boa experiência deve se transformar em retenção, venda de serviços e crescimento de receita , essa oportunidade é para você. Aqui, o atendimento ao cliente e pós-vendas é uma área estratégica e de geração de valor contínuo .


O seu desafio

Ser o protagonista no relacionamento e na gestão da experiência de clientes do segmento de unidades móveis e implementos rodoviários, garantindo que cada interação gere satisfação e fidelização, culminando em um NPS (Net Promoter Score) positivo . Você usará a voz do cliente para retroalimentar nossa melhoria contínua e, principalmente, para cavar novas oportunidades de vendas na base ativa.


O que você vai fazer na prática

  • Farming e Geração de Receita: Identificar oportunidades reais de negócios na base de clientes, atuando ativamente na venda de peças, serviços e upgrades (cross-sell e upsell).
  • Ponte Técnica (Manutenção e Garantia): Atuar lado a lado e de forma muito próxima às equipes de Manutenção, Garantia e Assistência Técnica. Você será o elo para resolver problemas complexos com agilidade e transformar eventuais atritos em confiança.
  • Educação e Encantamento (Parceria com Marketing): Trabalhar a quatro mãos com o time de Marketing na criação de materiais sobre nossos produtos. O objetivo é duplo: encantar e educar o cliente na ponta (guias, tutoriais, melhores práticas), e garantir o treinamento e a capacitação da nossa equipe interna.
  • Gestão de Experiência e NPS: Monitorar indicadores de satisfação, coletar feedbacks profundos e usar esses dados (NPS) para influenciar diretamente a melhoria contínua de nossos produtos e processos internos.
  • Atuação Consultiva: Acompanhar clientes estratégicos de transporte e logística, entendendo a operação de cada um, conduzindo reuniões de follow-up e reviews, e antecipando problemas antes que virem cancelamentos.
  • Gestão de CRM: Registrar, monitorar e tracionar o engajamento e as oportunidades dos clientes utilizando plataformas de CRM (como RD Station ).
  • Onboarding: Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e na aplicação do manual do cliente.


O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em Pós-Venda focado em expansão, Customer Success B2B ou Relacionamento com o Cliente.
  • Veia comercial: Facilidade com negociação, vendas de serviços/peças e identificação de oportunidades.
  • Domínio de CRM: Experiência prática com ferramentas de gestão de relacionamento, com destaque para RD Station CRM (ou similares de mercado).
  • Capacidade analítica para lidar com indicadores (NPS, Churn, LTV) e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Excelente comunicação para transitar entre a linguagem técnica (engenharia/oficina) e a linguagem de marketing/vendas.
  • Resiliência e jogo de cintura para lidar com clientes exigentes e construir pontes produtivas internamente.

title: Application Developer - Mendix
description:
Accepting CVs in English Only.

Job Level : Independent Contributor, 3 Years minimum experience

English Level : C1 (Professional)

Location : Remote, Contractor (Brazil, Colombia or Latin America countries only)


Application Developer – Mendix


The Application Developer - Mendix will work across teams to design, develop, and implement Applications leveraging Mendix low-code / no-code platform as part of the Integration and Development team within the client’s Technology department. This candidate will collaborate with internal client teams and work with external consultants when needed to deliver web and mobile solutions for various client business units. 

The Application Developer – Mendix will be responsible for developing and maintaining solutions built upon the Mendix platform, as well as responsible for integrating with SAP, Mulesoft and a wide variety of systems internally. This role will also be required to build processes to account for change control, governance and development of best practices for all Mendix applications built for internal and external use.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, code, test, and deploy software applications based on business requirements using Mendix low-code platform.
  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements.
  • Design intuitive user interfaces and efficient back-end workflows.
  • Perform code reviews, debugging, and unit testing.
  • Maintain and improve the performance and reliability of existing applications.
  • Write clean, scalable, and well-documented code.
  • Integrate Mendix applications with external systems and APIs.
  • Participate in agile development cycles, including planning, sprints, and reviews.
  • Troubleshoot issues and provide maintenance support for existing applications.
  • Implement best practices for coding, security, and performance.
  • Write technical documentation and user guides as needed.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. 
  • 3+ years of experience in Application Development.
  • Mendix Rapid Certification Required
  • Mendix Intermediate Developer certification (Preferred).
  • Proficiency in Mendix microflows, nanoflows, and domain modeling.
  • Experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of low-code development principles and agile methodology.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or other front-end technologies.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Clinical Trial Manager / Senior Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Clinical Trial Manager (CTM)/Sr CTM, Clinical Operations


Nexcella, Inc.


Our 3 Core Values

  • Intelligence
  • Integrity
  • Initiative


What You'll Do

The Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) leads the strategic and operational execution of cell therapy clinical trials, owning the full patient treatment pathway from apheresis through manufacturing, product release, and infusion. Serving as the cross-functional integrator across Clinical Operations, CMC, Manufacturing, Regulatory, Medical, Quality, and Supply Chain. The CTM ensures seamless execution, strict chain of identity and custody, inspection readiness, and on-time delivery of critical study milestones while safeguarding patient safety and product integrity


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the day-to-day operational execution of assigned cell therapy trials: study startup, site activation, enrollment, monitoring, close-out.
  • Develop and manage study timelines, budgets, forecasts, and related operational metrics.
  • Partner with external vendors / CROs / service providers (monitoring, labs, imaging, manufacturing/supply chain for cell product) to ensure high quality and timely deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary cross-functional operational contact for study teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, regulatory, safety/pharmacovigilance, manufacturing, supply chain, medical affairs, quality).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and quality standards (FDA, EMA, ICH-GCP, relevant local regulations) and internal SOPs.
  • Participate in protocol development and amendments, informed consent form (ICF) review, CRF/data tool development, TMF (Trial Master File) setup & maintenance, monitoring plan, data review plan, drug/cell-product accountability and reconciliation.
  • Oversee site feasibility, selection, contracting, start‐up (site initiation visits, training, enrollment & retention strategies) and close‐out activities.
  • Monitor study progress, identify risks/issues (enrollment delays, monitor/vendor performance, budget overruns, data quality issues) and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Foster effective communication across study teams, escalate issues to senior leadership as needed.
  • Ensure preparation for audits/inspections, maintain high standards of documentation readiness.
  • Contribute to lessons-learned and process improvement initiatives, particularly around cell-therapy-specific operational challenges (e.g., chain of identity/chain of custody, logistics of product, unique site training).
  • Review invoices and track study budget according to the forecast, working closely with finance and clinical business operations.
  • Develop study documents and tools including study, informed consent forms, project plans, budgets, study templates, and other materials as needed.
  • Vendor Management – Contribute to or lead cross-program vendor management activities
  • Contribute to SOP development within the Clinical Operations team

Qualifications

  • B.S. degree with minimum 7-10 years of experience in clinical operations including managing clinical trials in biotech, pharmaceutical.
  • Strong clinical study conduct experience from start-up through close-out.
  • Strong leadership, effective decision making, and problem-solving skills required.
  • Established Cell Therapy /CAR T study experience preferred.
  • Working knowledge of relevant GCPs and FDA/EMA regulations.
  • Knowledgeable of current ICH GCP guidelines and applicable regulations.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision and multi-task activities to effectively manage deliverables across all trials.
  • Experience in small/mid biotechnology environment (startup mindset)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills


About Nexcella, Inc.

Nexcella, Inc. is a subsidiary of Immix Biopharma, Inc. (ImmixBio) (Nasdaq: IMMX), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing cell therapies for AL Amyloidosis and other serious diseases. Our lead candidate is sterically-optimized BCMA-targeted chimeric antigen receptor T (CAR-T) cell therapy NXC-201 with a “digital filter” that filters out non-specific activation. NXC-201 is being evaluated in the U.S. multi-center study for relapsed/refractory AL Amyloidosis NEXICART-2 (NCT ), with a registrational design. Interim results were presented at ASCO 2025 in an oral presentation by Heather Landau, M.D. of Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. NXC-201 has been awarded Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) by the US FDA and Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) by FDA and in the EU by the EMA. Learn and

Diferenciais:
