title: Especialista em Design de Calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
  • Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
About the Company

We are a US-Based executive search firm focused on post-acute healthcare leadership. At our core, we are a sales organization, not an HR firm.



About the Role

We are hiring a high-level operator in Brazil to take ownership of our recruiting infrastructure, sourcing engine, and AI-driven systems.



Responsibilities

  • Run the current recruiting operations engine
  • Manage sourcing + data execution
  • Simultaneously build the future state using AI and automation



Core Responsibilities

Own Recruiting Operations (Day-to-Day Execution)

  • Manage full workflow: job intake → sourcing → outreach → submission → close
  • Ensure speed, organization, and execution across all active searches
  • Identify and prioritize revenue-generating activities
  • Maintain operational consistency across the team



Lead Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Personally drive sourcing on key searches (this is not purely managerial)
  • Build and optimize candidate pipelines using:
  • LinkedIn
  • CRM systems
  • Data tools and enrichment workflows
  • Manage and oversee a data/sourcing support resource
  • Improve speed, quality, and output of candidate identification


AI & Automation Implementation

  • Introduce and deploy AI tools to improve:
  • Sourcing
  • Outreach
  • Note-taking
  • CRM updates
  • Workflow automation
  • Build prompt libraries and repeatable systems
  • Identify where AI replaces manual effort and increases output
  • Continuously test and refine AI-driven workflows


CRM & Database Infrastructure

  • Own and evolve our CRM ecosystem (primarily Crelate and Outplay)
  • Redesign database structure (contacts, companies, work history, tagging)
  • Lead long-term strategy around:
  • Data quality
  • Searchability
  • AI-readiness of the database
  • Develop scalable processes for data enrichment and maintenance


Sales Process Alignment

  • Operate with a sales-first mindset
  • Understand how sourcing, outreach, and process directly impact revenue
  • Support pipeline generation and deal flow
  • Ensure systems are built to increase placements, not just organization


Qualifications

  • Fluent English + U.S. Business Acumen (Non-Negotiable)
  • Strong verbal and written English
  • Comfortable operating in a U.S.-based business environment
  • Understands expectations around speed, communication, and accountability


Required Skills

  • AI & Systems-Oriented Thinker
  • Experience using AI tools in a business setting (LLMs, automation, workflows)
  • Strong understanding of prompt engineering and practical application
  • Ability to evaluate tools and implement quickly
  • CRM & Operations Experience
  • Hands-on experience with CRM/ATS systems (Crelate, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.)
  • Experience building or improving workflows and data systems
  • Strong understanding of database structure and data integrity
  • Sourcing & Recruiting Exposure
  • Experience in recruiting, executive search, or talent sourcing preferred
  • Understands how to identify and engage high-level candidates
  • Comfortable operating in a performance-driven, search environment
  • Operator Mentality
  • Moves fast and prioritizes what drives revenue
  • Can manage execution while building systems simultaneously
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and building from scratch
  • Takes ownership—does not wait for direction


What This Role Is NOT

  • Not HR
  • Not administrative support
  • Not a passive “systems manager”



This is a hands-on operator role responsible for:

  • Driving sourcing output
  • Improving systems
  • Building AI infrastructure
  • Supporting revenue growth



What Success Looks Like

  • Faster, more consistent sourcing pipelines
  • Cleaner, more powerful CRM and database structure
  • AI meaningfully reducing manual work
  • Increased output per recruiter
  • Systems that scale the business without adding headcount


Industry Exposure

You will gain deep exposure to:

  • Executive search
  • Post-acute healthcare (SNF, senior living, home health, hospice)
  • High-level operators and leadership teams across the U.S.


Equal Opportunity Statement

We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: SAP GRC Senior Lead
description:
SAP GRC Senior Lead - Sao Paulo-Guararema


Mars is a family-owned business with over $50 billion in global sales, producing iconic brands like M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, and more. We operate in 80+ countries and are guided by our Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. Join our 150,000 Associates in creating the world we want tomorrow.


Role Overview

Step into a high-impact leadership role as SAP GRC Senior Lead within Mars Global Services, our shared services division, and help shape the future of Mars Inc. through our Digital Core transformation. The Digital Core is Mars’ strategic initiative to modernize and unify our SAP landscape, leveraging S/4HANA on RISE to drive operational excellence, security, and compliance across our global business.


In this role, you will be responsible for the technical design, configuration, deployment, and ongoing operation of the SAP Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system—an essential component of our Digital Core. The GRC Access Control (AC) system enables compliant user access processes, including access request provisioning, segregation of duties, and emergency access management (Firefighter), ensuring that only the right people have the right access at the right time.


Reporting to the SAP Security Senior Manager, you will collaborate closely with the Digital Core Security Team and Controls Team to ensure the GRC AC system is robust, scalable, and ready to support ongoing go-lives and deployments of user populations onto the Digital Core S/4HANA platform. You will also provide oversight and guidance for the steady-state operations of the GRC AC solution, helping Mars maintain the highest standards of security and compliance as we continue our transformation journey.


What are we looking for?

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience configuring SAP GRC Access Control, including MSMP workflow, BRF+ configuration, connector setup, rule set creation, and master data management
  • Proven experience implementing SAP security and GRC in S/4HANA transformation programs, with a strong understanding of GRC’s role in project lifecycles
  • Deep knowledge of SAP security role-based access controls, IT General Computer Controls, segregation of duties, sensitive access risks, and mitigating controls
  • Expertise in SAP identity management concepts such as user provisioning, access reviews, terminations, and single sign-on
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with SAP Basis, Identity, and Architecture teams to design integrated security solutions involving GRC
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) implementation is a plus
  • Strong communication skills to present complex GRC and security topics to both technical and business audiences


What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Own the end-to-end SAP GRC solution for the new S/4HANA on RISE Digital Core landscape
  • Design and enhance SAP GRC solution architecture to meet evolving business needs
  • Integrate SAP GRC with other systems and data sources to ensure seamless compliance management
  • Configure GRC Access Control workflows, rule sets, and security roles with precision
  • Manage GRC master data setup and conduct thorough testing aligned with S/4HANA transformation phases
  • Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, and troubleshoot complex GRC issues
  • Create and maintain comprehensive GRC configuration and training documentation
  • Lead knowledge transfer sessions to Mars SAP Security AMS support teams to ensure smooth steady-state operations
  • Support SAP Security Project Team in planning and incorporating GRC tasks into S/4 implementation timelines and status reporting


What can you expect from Mars?

  • Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles
  • Join a purpose-driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today
  • Best-in-class learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University
  • An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus


Mars is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need assistance or an accommodation during the application process because of a disability, it is available upon request. The company is pleased to provide such assistance, and no applicant will be penalized as a result of such a request.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

description:

title: Tech Lead (Iniciativas de IA)
description:

 - Ambiente de alta performance com metas claras

 - Possibilidade de crescimento para Closer

title: FP&A Director
description:
We are seeking an FP&A Director for a large multinational technology company, one of the leading global players in its segment, to lead a globally operating FP&A Hub .


The FP&A Director will be responsible for leading and structuring a high-impact team focused on providing strategic insights and financial guidance to senior stakeholders across the organization. This role is accountable for the end-to-end financial planning cycle , including forecasting, budgeting, performance tracking and financial analysis, ensuring robust support for business decision-making and operational efficiency.


Acting as a key business partner , this professional will work closely with Finance Directors, Vice Presidents and Corporate leadership, playing a pivotal role in strengthening financial governance, supporting executive decisions and driving the consolidation of financial performance across all business units.


RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Take full ownership of the P&L, covering both actual results and forward-looking projections, for internal and external purposes;
  • Lead the Mid-Term planning cycle, actively contributing to long-term strategic decision-making;
  • Coordinate monthly and quarterly closing processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery of financial information;
  • Consolidate results across all Americas operations, providing visibility into variances and underlying business drivers beyond purely technical consolidation;
  • Deliver structured and insightful analysis to senior stakeholders, including the CFO and executive committees, supporting key business decisions;
  • Drive target-setting processes and ensure adherence to financial guidelines across the region.
  • Lead, engage, and develop a large team, setting clear direction, expectations, and promoting a high-performance culture;
  • Act as a transformation agent, promoting efficiency improvements, leveraging new tools and systems, and challenging existing processes;
  • Maintain strong interaction with senior management, providing regular updates and guidance on financial plans;
  • Ensure clear direction for the team, including goal-setting, performance expectations, and ongoing professional development support;
  • Manage and develop a team of financial analysts.


QUALIFICATIONS


  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Accounting, or a related field;
  • Fluency in English is mandatory;
  • Professional accounting certification is considered a plus;
  • Solid experience in FP&A and/or financial analysis roles;
  • Proven track record in leading large teams, including leadership of team leads;
  • Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling;
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, including CFO-level;
  • Previous experience in multinational companies or dynamic, fast-paced environments;
  • Experience in a Big Four firm is considered a strong plus;
  • Advanced proficiency in SAP and Excel; familiarity with automation and BI tools is a plus.

description:

title: Talent Data Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.


Key responsibilities:


- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.


Requirements:


- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

y capabilities and behaviour:

  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills, an analytical mindset and outstanding attention to detail.
  • Experience designing and developing javascript web applications using Node.Js, Angular 2+, CSS3, HTML5 and Javascript.
  • Experience developing middleware, integration and messaging systems using REST APIs and popular message bus platforms (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).

  • Ability to work efficiently with remote teams using collaboration technology.
  • Ability to identify issues and solve complex problems as part of a team.
  • Ability to lead small development teams and foster strong working relationships (only for leads).
  • Ability to remain calm when under pressure and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to resolving problems.


Ideally, you will also have:

  • Knowledge of ORM/ODM like Sequelize and Mongoose.
  • Experience with microservices architectures and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience designing, developing and automating unit tests.
  • Strong understanding of source code version control, including the use of Git repositories.
  • Experience working on projects that follow an Agile Scrum methodology.
  • Strong awareness of system development life cycles (SDLC).
  • Good understanding of relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or any other.

title: Ejecutivo de Vendas B2B
description:
As responsabilidades específicas incluirão, mas não estão limitadas a:

  • Atuar na área comercial da empresa em dos canais, respondendo pelas vendas de uma carteira de clientes;
  • Administrar e desenvolver contas estratégicas, identificarndo novas oportunidades de negócios por meio do levantamento de informações de mercado;
  • Manter contato ativo com os clientes de sua carteira, buscando apoiá-los em suas necessidades;
  • Promover a prospecção inbound e outbound de clientes B2B; atendimento e negociação por telefone; presencial (sendo responsável pelo atendimento de clientes em nosso showroom e visitas externas, quando necessário) e demais atendimentos através multicanais de comunicação corporativo (e-mail, WhatsApp business, plataforma B2B Vtex, etc.);
  • Elaborar planejamento de vendas, propostas comerciais e follow up do processo de vendas;
  • Analisar concorrência, tendências e condições do mercado para aceitação de nossos produtos;
  • Responder pela gestão da carteira de pedidos de seus clientes, monitorando toda a cadeia do pedido;
  • Realizar follow up com as demais áreas da empresa, como administração de vendas, customer marketing, financeiro, logística e pós-vendas para garatir o sucesso das vendas;
  • Colaborar com a área de Trade Marketing Digital e Customer Marketing para elaboração de ações e campanhas para aumentar engajamento e conversão;
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento do calendário mensal de ações para ativação das marcas do portfólio de acordo com a estratégia comercial para seus clientes;
  • Participar de feiras, convenção de vendas e demais eventos, buscando a aproximação com os clientes, representantes e demais áreas da empresa;
  • Mantem-se sempre atualizado quanto aos produtos da empresa, sua aplicação e informações técnicas.



Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo (Administração, Marketing, Logística e áreas afins);
  • Mínimo 3 anos de experiência na função de vendas externas ou interna.


Experiência

  • Informática - Pacote Office (intermediário/avançado);
  • Datasul e/ou sistemas da área;
  • Técnicas de vendas e negociações;
  • Conhecimento do negócio e produtos;
  • Gestão de estruturação de KPI'S;
  • Normas de segurança e políticas da qualidade;
  • 5S'S;
  • Planejamento e controle das ações e/ou projetos de sua área de expertise;
  • Orientação para resultados.

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)



Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra Focused)
description:
Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizationalstructure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Responsibilities:

- You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the our UI and the terminal

- You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow

- You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product.


Work Hours : This role is dedicated to supporting our APAC region. For colleagues based in Brazil, the standard working hours are 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM (BRT) to ensure seamless collaboration with our global teams and clients


Main Skills:

  • Proven experience in B2B customer support , supporting software platforms or technical products in a customer-facing environment
  • Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix environments , including CLI navigation, file management, and log analysis for troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals , including the OSI model and protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP/HTTPS
  • Foundational knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with cloud and infrastructure models , including Cloud, On-premise, and Hybrid environments
  • Understanding of ITIL principles and production service standards, including SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs
  • Strong communication skills , with the ability to clearly explain complex technical issues to stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deploying and managing resources)
  • Basic proficiency in scripting (e.g., Bash, Python)


Soft Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a data-driven approach
  • High attention to detail with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive attitude with a strong focus on customer support and service
  • Motivation to learn, grow, and contribute to a collaborative environment
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken)
  • Strong customer empathy and ability to adapt communication style accordingly
  • Ability to set clear expectations and consistently meet agreed timelines

title: Salesforce Architect
description:
Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Architect
  • Coming from an admin/engineer technical background
  • Deep knowledge of Salesforce product
  • Sales Cloud
  • Service Cloud
  • Marketing Cloud
  • Experience with the newest version (Agentforce Marketing)
  • Able to work EST time zone

Day to Day:

We are looking for a strong Salesforce Architect to support one of our clients. Our client has been using an in-house built CRM tool for a while, and currently in the process of implementing Salesforce. This implementation is set to be completed mid-year, and they would like to bring on a Salesforce Architect to not only assist with the implementation but help oversee the Salesforce environment post implementation. This individual will mainly be responsible for true architect functions but will need to also come from a hands-on technical background in salesforce to assist the team of admins. This architect will be responsible for the following:

  • Product road mapping
  • Advising on best practices, standards, and architectural guardrails
  • Supporting the technical team as an escalation POC
  • Working cross functionally with the business teams + technical teams
  • Translate business needs/processes into technical architecture and system design

title: Field de Support - CCNA

  • Experience MS Windows OS, O365 E1/E3/E5, AD, Single/MFA
  • Experience for EndUser support in record, diagnose and solve problems in the scope of microcomputing, hardware, operating systems, telephony, videoconferencing, web conferencing, audio conferencing and related areas, including performing any corrective maintenance on ICT equipment;
  • Experience to clarify doubts and guide users regarding the use, availability, installation and configuration of software, applications, information systems (both those in the market and those developed internally), equipment, standards and procedures on the technological environment of the Customer and its use
  • identify and immediately report to the Level 2 Service Supervisor critical problems that have significant impacts on the technological environment of Customer, exceptional situations and other situations beyond its control or jurisdiction;
